caption:
At 45, I went from 20% → 15% body fat while maintaining muscle mass. My next goal is 10%.

Here’s the thing most guys don’t realize:
 👉 Your hormones and insulin response might be the REAL reason you’re stuck with stubborn belly fat (I was for yrs). If you’re insulin resistant, those constant blood sugar spikes make it way harder to burn fat.

Here’s what worked for me:
 1️⃣ Prioritize protein – I aim for 1g per pound of bodyweight daily to maintain and build muscle while cutting fat.
 2️⃣ Walk 10–15k steps/day – Especially in the morning before eating (fasted LISS). It’s a game-changer for fat loss and insulin sensitivity.
 3️⃣ Lower carb intake – I stay under 130g per day to control blood sugar and keep fat loss moving.
 4️⃣ Track everything – I weigh my food and track macros daily. Accuracy matters more than motivation.
 5️⃣ Train 5–6 days/week – 2–3 days of resistance training + 2–3 days of HIIT (for me, usually Hyrox).

It’s not about starving yourself it’s about training smart, eating with intention, and managing your hormones so your body actually lets go of fat.

If you’re 35–45 and struggling with belly fat, these are the exact steps that got me results.
